newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 SURGE PETERS OUT AS KOMERCNI SLIPS BACK.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 SURGE PETERS OUT AS KOMERCNI SLIPS BACK.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index edged slightly higher at Thursday's fixing but the surge of recent days petered out as Komercni Banka fell back 12 crowns to 1,920.

Komercni and SPT Telecom have formed the main driving force behind strong gains in recent sessions. SPT continued to gain but at a less frenetic pace than in Wednesday's session. The issue rose 30 crowns to 4,253.
Power utility CEZ declined four crowns to 917. Some analysts say that CEZ, despite concerns about its short term prospects, still represents a good long term buy.
"Although CEZ's short to medium prospects are poor, CEZ 1 can be hardly traded below a CZK 900 support line in 1997," said Patrik Brom of Prague International Securities.
"At the start of the next century...CEZ will have completed its heavy investment programme and its solid cash-generating ability will make it highly attractive indeed," he added.
Brom rated CEZ as a long term buy.
